description: Source code for Plivo WebSocket frame serializer handling audio streaming, DTMF events, and call termination via Plivo API within the Pipecat project.

classes.name: PlivoFrameSerializer
classes.description: Serializer for Plivo WebSocket protocol, converting Pipecat frames to WebSocket messages and vice versa, with call control features.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Configures the serializer with pipeline sample rate from StartFrame.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Converts Pipecat frames into WebSocket messages, handles auto hang-up, and audio encoding.

methods.name: _hang_up_call
methods.description: Uses Plivo REST API to hang up the call asynchronously.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.description: Converts incoming WebSocket messages from Plivo into Pipecat frames, including media and DTMF events.
